representation_decision.hardware: Use real reusable source photos when they add material/finish information; use standardized generated/schematic assets for generic geometry such as curved tube, thin bezel, micro spacer and geometric connector.
representation_decision.packaging: Use reusable sources as structural evidence. Final display assets should be standardized/generated to match Crystal packaging direction because exact branded product photography is unnecessary and often copyrighted.
